title.zh: Microsoft recorded $10 billion in revenue from OpenAI
title.en: Microsoft recorded $10 billion in revenue from OpenAI

current_state.zh: Microsoft reported $10 billion in revenue from commercial arrangements with OpenAI, including revenue-sharing payments, for the quarter ended September 30, underscoring the scale and financial dependency of the partnership.
current_state.en: Microsoft reported $10 billion in revenue from commercial arrangements with OpenAI, including revenue-sharing payments, for the quarter ended September 30, underscoring the scale and financial dependency of the partnership.

updates.title_zh: 微软从 OpenAI 录得 100 亿美元收入
updates.title_en: Microsoft recorded $10 billion in revenue from OpenAI
updates.what_changed_zh:
微软表示，在截至 9 月 30 日的季度中，其从与 OpenAI 的商业安排（包括收入分成款项）中录得 100 亿美元收入。这一披露量化了微软当前营收对双方合作关系的依赖程度。

这一数字表明，该合作关系不仅是战略投资，仍是微软财报收入的直接且重要的来源。

这 100 亿美元涵盖截至 9 月 30 日季度内与 OpenAI 的商业安排，其中包括收入分成款项。微软尚未批准 OpenAI 提出的调整收入分成条款的方案。

updates.detailed_summary_en: Microsoft reported $10 billion in revenue from commercial arrangements with OpenAI, including revenue-sharing payments, for the quarter ended September 30, underscoring the scale and financial dependency of the partnership.
updates.background_zh: 微软与 OpenAI 自 2016 年起建立商业合作关系，微软于 2019 年投资 10 亿美元，此后成为 OpenAI 的主要云与基础设施提供方。根据现行协议，微软可获得 OpenAI 约 20% 的收入，据报上限为 920 亿美元，期限至 2030 年。据报道，OpenAI 希望降低这一比例，并提出以更多股权作为交换，但微软尚未同意相关调整。
updates.background_en: Microsoft and OpenAI have been commercially linked since 2016, with Microsoft investing $1 billion in 2019 and later becoming OpenAI's primary cloud and infrastructure provider. Under the existing agreement, Microsoft receives about 20% of OpenAI's revenue, up to a reported cap of $92 billion, through 2030. OpenAI has reportedly sought to reduce that percentage and has offered Microsoft a larger equity stake in exchange, but Microsoft has not agreed to the changes.
